fields.title: Our Policy
fields.no_refunds_text: Kindly note that all orders are final. We do not accept refunds or exchanges after the order has been received and accepted.
fields.inspection_text: Kindly inspect your order carefully upon delivery before accepting it. Please make sure that the item, size, color, and condition are as expected.
fields.refused_text: If you choose to refuse your order at the time of delivery, you may do so. However, the customer will be responsible for any applicable delivery and return shipping fees.
fields.damaged_text: If you receive an item that is damaged or incorrect, kindly contact Kimzie as soon as possible and provide your order details along with clear photos of the item. We will review the issue and assist you accordingly.
fields.confirmation_text: By placing an order with Kimzie, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to our policy before completing your purchase.
